LBY.note: Terms of a payment alias directory; no authentication, e-signature or PKI service described.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Only a generic promise to comply with data protection laws; no law named.
No count or share of people holding a national number.
Nothing on who operates the ID system.
A payment alias directory tied to the national number is a private-style service, not a public register.
A valid national number is required to register, but nothing on how the ID system issues or checks it.
